questions.prompt: You bust a $1/$2 cash buy-in. The correct next step is usually…

choices.text: You are eliminated from the casino event.
Rebuy within the table cap, or rack up and leave.
Wait for the bubble to burst.
The dealer must seat you in a satellite.

questions.explanation: Cash has no elimination ladder. A lost buy-in ends that stack, not the game.

questions.prompt: Which format uses a rising blind clock?

choices.text: A time-charge cash game with constant blinds

questions.explanation: Tournament blinds escalate. Standard cash blinds stay at the posted stakes.

questions.prompt: Hero has 200 big blinds and the villain has 40. The effective stack is…
questions.explanation: Effective stack is the smaller of the stacks that can go into the pot.

questions.prompt: A live cash table is most unlike a tournament because…

choices.text: Cash chips have no dollar value.
You must play until one player has every chip.
You can leave between hands and chips represent withdrawable money.

questions.explanation: Cash is an optional, continuous game. Chips are money, not tournament equity.
